Asobi 1.0.17 (build 2307) Nov 20, 2026

  • Showcases no longer get stuck packaging. Some clips stopped for good on "Packaging it for streaming — 1 of 3" while their picture and sound were joined into one stream. They now finish, and if packaging ever stalls the showcase stops with a reason instead of waiting forever.
Earlier updates

1.0.16 (build 2304) Nov 20, 2026

  • Showcases and web links no longer stall taking the sound. The clip's sound is read from the original once and reused, instead of up to three times, so a long movie on the server prepares much faster. The line under the bar shows the sound's progress, and if it stops moving for a minute the share goes on without it rather than waiting forever.

1.0.15 (build 2301) Nov 19, 2026

  • Frame.io sign-in no longer quits Asobi. Changing Adobe accounts on the sign-in page, or Adobe answering from the browser, could close Asobi without a word. It now finishes the sign-in or says why it didn't.

1.0.14 (build 2298) Nov 18, 2026

  • Guests Can Drive the Room. A new switch in the Review menu, under Guests Can Zoom the Room, while you host. Turn it off and people on the web link watch what you play: their play, steps, timeline, shot band and compare are greyed, and they stay on your clip and frame. They can still write notes, reply, draw and point. Turn it back on at any time. Stepping away or ending the review lets them drive again. Studio seats are not affected.

1.0.13 (build 2294) Nov 17, 2026

  • Progress on the web page. While you host a review whose shots are matched to Kitsu, people on the web link get a Progress tab beside Notes and Playlist: every shot's percentage and progress notes, and the agency's comments from this round. Drawn shows the agency's drawing on its frame. It is read only, and a review set to Review Notes Only doesn't show it.

1.0.12 (build 2291) Nov 17, 2026

  • Several reviews in one. File > Add Review to This One… adds another review's clips after these, with their notes, marks and grades. Dropping or opening a review file on a window that has clips asks whether to add it or open it instead. Each added review is a section in the Playlist that folds, and can be renamed or removed in one step that Undo brings back.
  • Click a header to choose it. Clicking a cut movie's or a section's header goes to it; Shift- or Command-click selects its shots. Right-click a header to publish just that section to Kitsu, make its Progress Report, or select its shots.
  • The Progress Report covers every cut you choose. The report's sheet lists the cuts, with the one on screen ticked: one PDF with a heading per cut, or a PDF for each cut. It used to cover only the first cut.
  • Kitsu playlists have a header in the Playlist, with the playlist's name, that folds and clicks like the others.
  • Open Recent shows an unsaved review as a review, named for what it holds (“Opening, Product + 2 more (Unsaved Review)”), instead of as one of its movies. It reopens as it was.
  • Fixed: changing clips while a sequence was first being read from Kitsu or Frame.io could freeze the window.

1.0.11 (build 2281) Nov 16, 2026

  • See the agency's drawings in Asobi. In the Progress tab, an agency comment that was drawn on in Frame.io has a Drawn button. Click it to go to that frame and see the drawing, in the agency's colors with the name of who drew it; click again to hide it. The frame is counted in the shot, so it lands on the same moment in a newer version.
  • The Overlay moves out of the way. While a drawing is on screen, the Overlay's words move to the top of the picture so they never cover it.

1.0.10 (build 2278) Nov 16, 2026

  • Publish All Shots to Kitsu. Review ▸ Kitsu has a new item that posts every shot's notes and marked frames at once, one comment on each shot's task. It leaves out comments that came from Kitsu or Frame.io, and anything already published, from either Publish sheet or by a live review.
  • Choose what goes in a PDF report. The Note Report asks which clips, which notes and whether to include the pictures; with pictures off it makes a quick text-only report. The Progress Report has Kura Hub's columns, can highlight this Frame.io round, and lets you leave shots out of the PDF without touching the Tracker.
  • The agency's drawings in an internal Progress Report. Turn on Agency frames to print each drawing on its frame of the movie, with a close-up of each place the agency drew. The PDF is marked Internal, and the switch is off again next time.
  • Long shots no longer run off the page in the Progress Report: a shot with a lot to say continues on the next page.

  • Showcases and web links no longer stall taking the sound. The clip's sound is read from the original once and reused, instead of up to three times, so a long movie on the server prepares much faster.
